summary: Faz-4+ Strategy Control Governance Testing Complete. All backend endpoints (22 tests) passed and frontend UI verified. Features tested: rollback-snapshots with timestamp/actor/action_type/diff_preview, rollback-request with reason validation and expires_at (24h), approval-requests with pending/expired/approved views, approve/reject endpoints (super_admin only), permission matrix (super_admin=full, admin=request_only, ops=read_only), drift-alerts with recommended_action (type/confidence/reason), policy-suggestions with taxonomy 24h/7d aggregation and rule-based suggestions.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/admin/futures/strategy/{id}/rollback-snapshots: Returns items with snapshot_trace_id, timestamp, actor, action_type, diff_preview, rollback_scope=single_strategy
POST /api/admin/futures/strategy/{id}/rollback-request: Validates reason (min 3 chars), validates snapshot_trace_id exists, creates request with preview and expires_at (24h)
GET /api/admin/futures/strategy/approval-requests: Returns pending/expired/approved items, super_admin sees all, admin sees own requests only
POST /api/admin/futures/strategy/approval-requests/{id}/approve: super_admin only, applies rollback from snapshot, adds rollback_reference to audit
POST /api/admin/futures/strategy/approval-requests/{id}/reject: super_admin only, marks request as rejected with decision_reason
Permission matrix correctly enforced: super_admin=full, admin=request_only (can read and create requests), ops=read_only (can read via require_admin)
GET /api/admin/futures/strategy-control/drift-alerts: Returns recommended_action with type (ACK/MUTE/DISABLE/RETRAIN), confidence (0-100), reason, and inputs
GET /api/admin/futures/strategy-control/policy-suggestions: Returns taxonomy_24h, taxonomy_7d aggregations and rule-based suggestions
Frontend Audit tab: Rollback snapshot panel with list, request form, approval workflow panel with approve/reject buttons, policy suggestions panel with 24h/7d/rules display
Frontend Drift tab: Alert cards show recommended_action with type, confidence percentage, and reason text

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All UI elements verified: rollback snapshot panel, approval workflow panel, policy suggestions panel, drift alert recommended action)
